goal: Add the smallest entry-write TUI application seam against the frozen CatalogService.create_entry contract without reopening runtime or frozen core
tests_explicitly_not_run: TUI runtime regression because runtime code is untouched
browser regression because web code is untouched
repository/domain/storage regression because frozen core is untouched
visual evidence because runtime layout is untouched
risks: the adapter accepts category_id explicitly but does not decide UI selection provenance; that remains for a separately gated integration step
the adapter is intentionally not connected to input, hotkeys, focus or refresh
non_changes: no trash/restore, undo, autosave or crash-recovery
no theme, dependency or CI changes
expected_side_effects: a later decision-only step can determine whether selected-category provenance and entry refresh justify a narrow CP-07T reopen
